name: race-condition
description: Read-through cache and request counter backed by async storage, wired together by a small service layer.

bugs.description: Cache.get performs a check-then-act sequence across an await: concurrent calls for the same key all observe the miss and each invoke the loader, so the check and the fill are not atomic (cache stampede).
increment reads the current value and writes current + 1 in two separate awaited steps, a non-atomic read-modify-write that loses updates when increments overlap.
